parsed.notes: Lens A review only; no external sources used.

reasons: Lake identity is verified for Brosseau v. Haugen, U.S. Supreme Court, decided 2004-12-13.
The official citation 543 U.S. 194 and the parallel/vendor citations in the payload match the lake citation fields and the content page header.

defect.problem: The pin-201 payload is not a character-faithful opinion quote; it includes content-page prose and citation text rather than the actual page-201 passage. The lake also marks this pinpoint quote_fidelity as mismatch.
defect.proposed_fix: Replace pin-201 with the exact opinion substring at 543 U.S. 201, or retarget the pin to the partial quote actually used on the content page.

reasons: The disclosed opinion text at star page 201 begins the relevant passage with the three-case discussion, not with a dash, Id., or the page's narrative lead-in.
The lake pinpoint for pin-201 has page null, star_marker null, and quote_fidelity mismatch.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Store only the exact opinion text in pinpoints[].quote; keep explanatory page prose outside the quote record.

defect.problem: The quote points to the correct sentence, but it is not raw character-faithful: the payload uses bracketed lowercase [t]he and single quotation marks where the cached opinion has initial uppercase text and double quotation marks.
defect.proposed_fix: Use exact source capitalization and quotation marks, or mark this as an altered legal quotation rather than a raw character-fidelity quote.

reasons: The sentence appears in the cached opinion at the same page-201 paragraph, so the substance and pin location are supportable.
Strict quote fidelity fails because the payload alters capitalization and quote punctuation, and the lake marks the pinpoint as mismatch.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: If bracketed alterations are allowed, separate legal-quotation fidelity from exact character-fidelity in the schema.

defect.problem: The pin-198 payload quote is a corrupted page excerpt containing issue/rule headings and page prose, not the opinion sentence quoted at 543 U.S. 198. The lake marks this pinpoint quote_fidelity as mismatch.
defect.proposed_fix: Replace pin-198 with the exact qualified-immunity sentence from the opinion text, or regenerate the pinpoint from the content page's actual quoted sentence.

reasons: The content page's displayed quote is present in the cached opinion, but the inventory/lake payload for this assertion is not that quote.
The payload includes Markdown section headings and surrounding reference-page material that are not part of the opinion text.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Pinpoint extraction should capture the quoted source sentence, not the nearest preceding Markdown block.

defect.problem: The quoted phrase is supported at page 199, but the stored quote is not raw character-faithful because it uses Markdown italics while the cached opinion stores the case names with HTML italics. The lake marks the pinpoint as mismatch.
defect.proposed_fix: Normalize formatting before quote-fidelity checks, or store a clean rendered-text quote without Markdown asterisks.

reasons: After accounting for formatting markup, the words and punctuation of the quoted proposition are present in the cached opinion at star page 199.
The lake pinpoint has no page/star marker and carries quote_fidelity mismatch, so it should not be treated as strict raw-character fidelity.
residual_risks: If the corpus requires exact raw HTML-text fidelity rather than rendered-text fidelity, this should be downgraded to refuted.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Define whether quote_fidelity compares rendered legal text or raw cached HTML, then normalize italics consistently.

reasons: Treatment/currency is outside Lens A, so I record the row without raising a treatment finding.
The content page treatment fields match the lake treatment judgment: field_i_validity good_law, as_of_treatment 2026-06-30, and varies_by_point false.
residual_risks: Treatment merits require Lens B review.
